# Copilot instructions for Sabor & Cia

This project is a small Flask storefront app in Portuguese.

## Project context
- Entry point: `app.py`
- Templates: `templates/`
- Styles: `static/style.css`
- Main routes: `/`, `/produtos`, `/sobre`

## Working rules
- Keep UI copy in Portuguese unless there is a clear reason to add English text.
- Follow the existing Flask + Jinja structure rather than introducing a new framework.
- Keep the app simple and static; avoid overengineering features not already present.
- Preserve the layout and branding of "Sabor & Cia".
- If new routes are added, ensure navigation and page links remain consistent.

## Validation
After modifying the app, verify it still starts without syntax errors and that the main routes render successfully.
